question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Decipher
solution:
The correct answer is **'Interpret'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Decipher**__**: To succeed in reading or understanding something that is not clear** **(कूट लेखन को पढ़ लेना या समझ लेना****)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- It’s impossible to **decipher** his handwriting.
 
 
 
• __**Interpret**__**: To explain or understand the meaning of something (किसी के अर्थ को समझाना****)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- Your silence could be **interpreted** as arrogance.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'Interpret'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Calculate__: To find something out by using mathematics (गणना करना****)**

 __
 
• **E.g.__​**- It’s difficult to **calculate** how long the project will take.
 
 
 
• **__Create__: To cause something new to happen or exist (कुछ नया उत्‍पन्‍न करना****)**
 __
 
• **E.g.__​**- A plan to **create** new jobs in the company**.**
 
 
 
• **​__Interrogate__: T****o ask somebody a lot of questions over a long period of time (किसी से लंबी पूछताछ करना****)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The prisoner was **interrogated** for six hours.
 
 

37:Te46,

The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**
